keyEvents.text: Goal! Sabah 0, Barcelona 1. Anthony Gordon (Barcelona) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
First Half ends, Sabah 0, Barcelona 1.
Substitution, Sabah. Joy-Lance Mickels replaces Xayal Aliyev.
Substitution, Barcelona. Dani Olmo replaces Pedri.
Goal! Sabah 0, Barcelona 2. Anthony Gordon (Barcelona) right footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Sabah 0, Barcelona 3. Karim Adeyemi (Barcelona) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Alejandro Balde.
Delay in match because of an injury Alejandro Balde (Barcelona).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Sabah 0, Barcelona 4. Gabriel Jesus (Barcelona) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner following a corner.
Substitution, Sabah. Aleksey Isayev replaces Du Queiroz.
Substitution, Sabah. Kaheem Parris replaces Xander Severina.
Goal! Sabah 1, Barcelona 4. Joy-Lance Mickels (Sabah) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Christian Nwachukwu.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Substitution, Barcelona. Álex Campos replaces Frenkie de Jong.
Substitution, Barcelona. João Cancelo replaces Alejandro Balde because of an injury.
Ivan Lepinjica (Sabah) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Akim Zedadka (Sabah).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Barcelona. Raphinha replaces Anthony Gordon.
Substitution, Sabah. Rahman Dasdamirov replaces Júnior Almeida.
Substitution, Sabah. Tellur Mütallimov replaces Akim Zedadka because of an injury.
Substitution, Barcelona. Brian Fariñas replaces Gavi.
